serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Welcome back! 
Bot: Did you find Melissa?
You: I did.
Bot: And? What did she tell you?
You: We had a long talk, but I don’t think I can tell you what she told me.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: What do you mean? Did something bad happen?
You: No, everything’s fine. It’s just that Melissa should be the one to tell you about it. When the time is right.
Bot: And when will that be?
You: I don’t know. Maybe never.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Never?! Does she have something against me? 
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Haha! No, I don’t think that’s the case. Give her some time, ok? 
Bot: I don’t understand, but sure. She can have all the time in the whole world.
